section_summary.extract_value: This section, the abstract, describes a single daily diary study that investigated the association between gratitude and loneliness across the adult lifespan. The study involved a sample of 128 participants with a mean age of 56.7 years (SD=18.7) and included 46% women. Key findings indicated a general negative association between gratitude and loneliness, with the beneficial effect of gratitude varying across age and gender.
